# StateHistory()

> **StateHistory**(`spec`: [`StateHistorySpec`](../interfaces/StateHistorySpec.md)): [`Definition`](../interfaces/Definition.md)

Defined in: [src/sdk/index.ts:486](https://github.com/maxmixalex/krieg-lang/blob/main/src/sdk/index.ts#L486)

Write a complete state history file. When replacing an existing state, give its exact native path and preserve the province membership that should remain in the state.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type |
| ------ | ------ |
| `spec` | [`StateHistorySpec`](../interfaces/StateHistorySpec.md) |

## Returns

[`Definition`](../interfaces/Definition.md)

## Example

```ts
StateHistory({ state: state(1), name: "STATE_1", owner: country("KRG"),
  manpower: 180000, category: "rural", provinces: [3838, 9851, 11804],
  buildings: { infrastructure: 2 }, path: "history/states/1-France.txt" });
```
